actual_scope: Prove that no set of 97 or more of the 120 E8 lines has a realisation of inner dimension exactly 8k under the complex label pattern (the pairing between line labels is forced zero exactly on non-orthogonal line pairs, with invertible diagonal blocks, stated as a hypothesis), over any field and for symmetric or asymmetric pairings. The obstruction is a 13-line Hall deficiency (an 8-clique of the forced-zero graph plus five pair lines on four of its coordinates); the minimum set of lines meeting every such configuration has exactly 24 lines. Ranks strictly between 8k and 9k for k >= 2, other masks, and line systems that are not subsets of the 120 E8 lines are not covered.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a helper-basis and causal-split construction on the complete invoice. This package is a rank obstruction for one label pattern on subsets of the 120 E8 lines; it constructs no word, prices nothing and splits nothing. It limits how many E8 lines a rank-8k route under that pattern can use.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the statement caps at 96 the number of E8 lines that any complete-invoice construction whose labels follow the stated pattern can carry at inner dimension 8k, so a construction needing 97 or more of them has to pay the next rank or change the pattern.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. The theorem is conditional on the complex label pattern, which is a hypothesis about how labels pair, not something proved here for any word; it says nothing for ranks strictly between 8k and 9k when k >= 2, for other masks, for line systems outside the 120 E8 lines, or for any pricing of a word. The bound 96 is not claimed attainable.
evidence: README.md (statement and self-contained proof), check.py (exact checks: strongly regular graph and spectral identity, the 13-line family with a Hall-deficiency test on every instance, reflections, the local SAT instance pinned by hash, counting, an explicit 24-line hitting set), retained/local-lemma.drat.xz (DRAT proof of the local instance).

open_questions.question: Is there a rank-8k realisation, under the same pattern, of some set of exactly 96 E8 lines, for instance the complement of the 24-line extremal hitting set?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem leaves 96 as the largest line count not excluded; a realisation would show the bound is sharp for realisability, and a further obstruction would lower it below the 97 that a 104-line construction would need anyway.
open_questions.first_step: Take the 96 lines outside the 24-line set listed in check.py (the complement of the nonsingular points of a totally singular 2-space's perpendicular), confirm it contains no F13 witness, and run the gauge-fixed k = 1 search over F_2 for that line set by fixing an 8-clique inside it and solving the remaining 88 lines' support systems with a SAT solver.
open_questions.blocked_by: None for the k = 1 search; no encoding of the full 96-line system has been written, and the Hall counting that closes F13 is not known to extend to a complete obstruction for larger configurations.

open_questions.question: Do ranks strictly between 8k and 9k (k >= 2) admit a realisation of 97 or more E8 lines under the same pattern?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The proof needs the gauge U_K = W_K = I, which exists only at inner dimension exactly 8k; a fractional saving per label block would be a different route from rank 9.
open_questions.first_step: For k = 2 and inner dimension 17, redo the gauge with one free extra column for one F13 witness (13 lines) and decide the resulting rank system over F_2 by exact linear algebra.
open_questions.blocked_by: The gauge needs invertible U_K, W_K, which holds only at inner dimension exactly 8k; the rank-sum argument has to be rewritten with an extra column.

open_questions.question: Which mechanism in a complex supplier forces the pairing to vanish on every non-orthogonal line pair, and can one forced zero inside each F13 witness be broken by a paid helper?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem is only as strong as the label pattern; a route at rank 8k has to break a forced zero inside every one of the 1,209,600 witnesses, and the minimum number of lines that meets all of them is 24.
open_questions.first_step: For one witness, list the frame contacts that produce the five O-line zeros with the K lines and the 8 sharing pairs, then remove one sharing pair from the mask and record by the k = 1 search in check.py whether the system becomes satisfiable.
open_questions.blocked_by: The derivation of the pattern from the supplier rules has not been written as a statement; without it a mask change cannot be priced.
